risks.title: Fluctuations in raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the context of food purchases, particularly cheese, the main ingredient cost. The language highlights ongoing exposure to price volatility, despite partially fixed-price agreements. Intensity is moderate to high, with direct impact on margin. The 'Industrial' category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international operations
risks.score_rationale: Presented in Item 7A, this risk affects 8.5% of revenues in 2025. An adverse 10% change in exchange rate would have a negative $15.1M impact on revenue. The language is quantified and precise, showing significant exposure. Not covered by historical hedges.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on debt
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to the PJI credit facility and interest rate swaps used to fix costs. Explicit mention of counterparty credit risk. Although managed through derivatives, the risk exists and is documented in financial notes. Language is technical but not alarming.

risks.title: Counterparty credit risk on derivatives
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of interest rate swaps, the risk of default by banking counterparties is explicitly cited. Although institutions are credit participants, the risk exists. Language is cautious but not alarming. 'Credit' category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Food cost volatility linked to inflation
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly links rising food costs to inflation, a major macroeconomic factor. Cheese, the main cost, is vulnerable. No financial hedging is used. The potential impact on earnings is clearly stated, with concerned but measured language.
